chunks: Some of the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله used to comb her hair and wash her head while she was menstruating.

key_terms.بَعْضُ: some; indicating that the report concerns some among the wives
key_terms.تُرَجِّلُ: she would comb and arrange the hair
key_terms.حَائِضٌ: menstruating; in the state of menstruation
key_terms.نِسَاءِ: wives/women; here referring to the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman comb her hair and wash her head?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that some of the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله would comb their hair and wash their heads during menstruation. It indicates the permissibility of such acts of personal cleaning while in the state of menstruation.
